name: Number of Averages (Vendor-Specific)
description: MY-RADS specifies vendor-specific NSA values. Philips uses different NSA for low b (3) and high b (10). Siemens uses 4-5 for high b. GE uses 4 for high b. All vendors may reduce NSA for low b-value images. (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
